Out of scope.

The state builds its own system, so this is out of scope; watch for a future seller-registration duty.

INEGE ran the first national business census in April 2024. The World Bank reports a one-stop shop and a 90% cut in minimum capital, with about 4,000 registrations in 2019-2023. The census is statistical, not a recurring duty. The speech PDF could not be read through WebFetch. Nothing to build.

result.duty: Employer-sponsored work and residence permits with renewals; penalties not quantified; legal basis unread
result.reason: Duty is plausible but not confirmed from primary law. Only consultancy and embassy pages (Globalization Partners, Rivermate, Spanish Embassy, BAL audit alerts) describe employer-sponsored permits (BI 1 year, BR 2 years, C 3 years) and more checks on foreigners. I found no statute text, fine amounts, or business counts. Ley 10/2012 was not read. No local tracking software or MTSS online portal turned up, but permits look paper-based and agent-driven. The buyer group is small and the process is informal and corruption-prone. Willingness to pay is weak, distribution is hard, and there is little data. Score stays low.
